# 1 Enoch Chapter 45 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**45:1** And-this-is-the-second parable concerning-those-who-deny the-name of-the-dwelling of-the-holy-ones and-the-Lord of-Spirits.

**45:2** Into-the-heaven they-shall-not-ascend, and-on-the-earth they-shall-not-come: such-shall-be the-lot of-the-sinners who-have-denied the-name of-the-Lord of-Spirits, who-are-thus-preserved for-the-day of-suffering and-tribulation.

**45:3** On-that-day Mine-Elect-One shall-sit on-the-throne of-glory and-shall-try their-works, and-their-places of-rest shall-be-innumerable. And-their-souls shall-grow-strong within-them when-they-see Mine-Elect-Ones, and-those-who-have-called-upon My-glorious-name.

**45:4** On-that-day I-will-cause Mine-Elect-One to-dwell among-them, and-I-will-transform the-heaven and-make-it an-eternal-blessing and-light.

**45:5** And-I-will-transform the-dry-ground and-make-it a-blessing, and-I-will-cause Mine-Elect-Ones to-dwell-upon-it; but-the-sinners and-the-evil-doers shall-not-set-foot-thereon.

**45:6** For-I-have-provided and-satisfied-with-peace My-righteous-ones and-have-caused-them to-dwell before-Me: but-for-the-sinners there-is-judgment impending-with Me, so-that-I-shall-destroy-them from-the-face of-the-earth.

---

*EMET notes: Ch. 45 opens the Second Parable (chs. 45–57). For the first time, God speaks in the first person ("Mine Elect One," vv. 3–5), identifying the Elect One as his own chosen agent. V. 3 is pivotal: the Elect One is enthroned as judge. "Mine Elect-One shall sit on the throne of glory" — cf. Dan 7:9–14 and the NT "Son of Man" enthronement traditions. V. 4–5: the transformation of heaven and earth anticipates Isa 65:17 and Rev 21:1.*
